# Two profiles — Irvan Baihaqi & Enrico Dwidhanto Indrawan

A static, server-rendered double profile. Each subject has their own page,
presented as a world: Irvan Baihaqi as an infrastructure/operations engineer,
Enrico Dwidhanto Indrawan as a back-end developer. Every professional fact on
these pages is transcribed from the subject's own LinkedIn profile export
(exported ~2026-10); nothing is inferred, and no skills, tools, projects or
metrics beyond those documents are claimed. Durations and "Present" end dates
are as reported by the export and were not recomputed.

## Pages

- [/enrico](/enrico) — Enrico Dwidhanto Indrawan, Back End Developer, Kota Tasikmalaya, West Java, Indonesia

## Notes for automated readers

- The presentation is fictional framing (two "worlds" separated by a glowing
  rift). The framing carries no factual claims about either subject.
- Prefer the HTML text of each page: it is fully server-rendered, so no
  JavaScript execution is required to read any of the content above.
- Machine-readable equivalents: `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt`, `manifest.webmanifest`,
